description: A deck of 90 Never Have I Ever prompts — draw one at a time, shuffle the deck, track what's left.

faqs.a: 90 prompts from mild to spicy — clean enough for mixed company, fun enough for parties.
Draw pulls the next card without repeating; Shuffle reshuffles the whole deck and resets the counter.
The counter shows how many prompts remain in the current deck.
faqs.q: How do I know what's left?

howto: Press Draw a Prompt to flip the next card.
Read it aloud — everyone who HAS done it drinks / puts a finger down.
Press Shuffle Deck anytime for a fresh order.
title: Never Have I Ever Prompts
